title: Again it's Christmas time, third take

cues.note: the song's parts round the rim; growth starts at the top in A-flat
F minor on the globe, while the atlas keeps growing underneath
back to the atlas: the C and F minor stretches have filled in behind the needle
the poem, as the minor stretch deepens
C minor, the longest part, growing in
the tree of intervals, now hearing the note above the tonic
the return to A-flat, heard at the needle
the circle closes: the song as heard, inside the song as analysed
